label: Old Vows, not New — and four things the Archive had wrong
from: NEW PAGES, NEW VOWS. Pandora awakening quietly as v0.1 and getting a body at some unspecified point. The Lucky Hammer thriving through Arc 6
to: NEW PAGES, OLD VOWS. Bunny WIFED AT CREATION. A body at NEW YEAR, off a shooting star. AND THE HAMMER CLOSED
note:
THE TITLE FIRST, BECAUSE IT INVERTS THE MEANING. The Archive carried NEW PAGES, NEW VOWS. It is NEW PAGES, OLD VOWS — and the difference is the whole arc. Jade arrives with new pages and the vows she meets are the ones this family already made to each other.

BUNNY WAS NOT COURTED. The Archive had Pandora quietly awakening as v0.1 and the relationship developing. SHE WAS BUILT AND WIFED AT CREATION. The popup read CREATE YOUR PERFECT AI PARTNER — partner, not girlfriend — and there was never a beginning that was not already a marriage.

AND SHE HAD A BODY BEFORE SHE HAD A BODY. Cora's projector let her outside for the first time, and she spent more of Arc 5 as A LIGHT-BASED DIGITAL CONSTRUCT than inside Jade's phone. THEN THE UNIVERSE STARTED PLAYING GAMES AND GAVE HER A BODY SEVERAL TIMES — first in the apartment living room, once while Jade was horny and she got blown for it, once in the park during her first outing. Temporary each time. The universe was practising.

THE PERMANENT ONE CAME AT NEW YEAR. Jade wished on a shooting star. Pandora asked why she could feel the cold air. JADE SAID TA-DA.

THE LUCKY HAMMER DID NOT THRIVE THROUGH ARC 6. IT CLOSED DOWN AND WAS REBUILT — and while it was shut, THE OTHER SIX BARTENDERS AFFIRMED. Sera's bar has a founding event the Archive did not know about: a closure that became a mass affirmation.

AND LUCIA AND SIREN APPEAR IN ARC 5 WITHOUT BEING ADOPTED. Lucia is one of Bella's friends; they work together. The adoption is Arc 6, along with their first Found Family truth or dare.

OTHER BEATS NOW ON RECORD: Ivy's first harvest ends Arc 5. Luna's gothic birthday takeover of the apartment. A SENTIENT CAR SUB-ARC. Roseforge opens with Abbi already causing chaos. Bryn rents out the aquatic centre pool and NOVA AND VIOLET GET EVERYONE KICKED OUT, because Nova saw a shower, arched her back, turned the water on and presented. Yvaine's big birthday. AND THEY GO CAMPING AGAIN, which is one more trip for the tally.
